verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several self-hosting paths: Docker Compose, an official Helm chart, and OpenShift and Rancher deployments for private cloud or on-prem environments. Community users independently confirm running self-hosted instances successfully (Docker/Portainer, 'self-deploy'). Missing for 10: consistent stability — some self-hosters report crashes and lag on their own instances, though this does not contradict that self-hosting is delivered.
